about.crawler.identity.user_agent.description: Sentence before the User-Agent of the crawler, shown as code. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.opt_out.directives.rest.description: What no page directive removes from a card. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.opt_out.directives.where.defaultMessage: 把它们写在页面头部名为 robots 或 my-linkcard 的 meta 标签中，或写在 X-Robots-Tag 标头中：
